en.headline: Saltwater main bursts in Tsuen Wan sending jet up to 10 metres high
en.dek: Water Supplies Department staff shut off the valve after a rupture on Tai Pa Street early Monday disrupted traffic and damaged the pavement.
body: A saltwater main burst outside 23 to 25 Tai Pa Street in Tsuen Wan early on Monday morning, sending a jet of water up to about 10 metres high and disrupting local traffic.

Police received a report at about 5am. Water Supplies Department personnel arrived shortly afterwards and closed the supply valve. The force of the water washed away part of the pavement, leaving a hole roughly one metre by one metre and scattering sand and stones across the carriageway. A section of the road was cordoned off.
The Water Supplies Department said it was carrying out repairs. No injuries were reported. Traffic in the area was affected while the water was still flowing.

zh.headline: 荃灣大壩街鹹水管爆裂 水柱一度高達約10米
zh.dek: 水務署人員清晨到場關閉水揇，路面被沖出約一米乘一米的洞，交通一度受影響。
body: 荃灣大壩街23至25號對開一條鹹水主管道於周一清晨爆裂，噴出水柱一度高達約10米，影響附近交通。
警方約凌晨5時接報。水務署人員隨後到場關閉供水閥門。水流沖起部分路磚，留下約一米乘一米的凹洞，沙石散落行車道。受影響路段已拉上封鎖線。
水務署表示正在搶修。事件沒有造成傷亡報告。水勢受控前，附近交通一度受阻。
